rare_diseases.description: Open Targets disease metadata for 5,388 returned diseases among 6,730 MONDO IDs queried. Each record retains full provider count and only the top 100 associated targets per disease, plus all candidate drug rows returned by the GraphQL field.

target_associations.description: Top 100 aggregate Open Targets target-disease scores per matched disease, with per-datatype and per-datasource contributions. This is capped and is not a full evidence table.

drug_candidates.description: Open Targets clinical candidate drug records from disease GraphQL pages. The corresponding disease-level provider candidate count matched returned row counts for this harvest.

grin_gene_disease_evidence.description: All cursor-paginated Open Targets source-native evidence records for MONDO diseases asserted/linked to GRIN2A or GRIN2B by ClinGen, GenCC, HPO or Orphadata. Evidence model scalar fields and nested first-level scalar fields were selected from the current GraphQL schema.

provider_release: Current Open Targets GraphQL API; release identifier not exposed in response (captured 2026-10-03). FTP index had 26.09 listed current, but this API response is not asserted to be pinned to that release.

coverage.limitation: Partial rare-disease slice via 6,730 MONDO identifiers mapped from RareSource OMIM/Orphanet xrefs; 5,388 returned and 1,342 did not resolve in the current API. Aggregate target associations limited to top 100 per disease (4,753 diseases had more; complete source-native evidence fetched separately only for 13 GRIN2A/GRIN2B disease IDs). Candidate drug count matched rows for all returned diseases. Full underlying evidence for other targets was not requested.

rights: Open Targets Platform data; provider documentation describes CC BY 4.0; review current release terms

evidence_dataset.selection: All Evidence scalar fields plus nested objects' direct scalar fields; paged until provider cursor exhausted. This focused dataset is complete for the 13 disease IDs linked to GRIN2A/GRIN2B by listed curated sources.
